screenshots.description: Unified eighteen-module current Windows workbench; Absolutely light
M01: real natural speech, task-authored demonstration TextGrid, actual Praat F0/F1/F2 task and spectrogram
M02: one actual plot window containing three analyzed parameter curves; empty plot removed through its normal UI
M04: actual LPC spectrum, 1.80–1.95 s natural speech
M03: formal manual EGG stereo original, continuous voiced 40–41 s, actual CQ/SQ and microscopic waveforms
M12: natural speech and task-authored single-tier demonstration TextGrid
M06: actual Klatt parameter extraction from natural speech; editable tracks, natural manual demonstration input
M07: F0 extracted from two natural speech recordings for source and target comparison
Actual user-authorized ma monosyllable; imported 230-to-110 Hz falling F0 and completed whole-clip synthesis with original/output waveforms
Actual grayscale spectrogram image reconstructed through normal image mode, with completed audio waveform and calibrated/reconstructed spectrogram comparison
M10: native vocal tract geometry with articulator controls; no synthetic audio example
M05: acquisition mode and device controls; camera and microphone remain idle
M11: natural speech and existing transcript imported, official resources and independent component installation UI
Complete 36-line, 252-character Chunjiang Huayueye by Zhang Ruoxu input and converted IPA; source Wikisource, simplified characters
M17: interactive IPA chart and symbol input
Actual author-specified 5453-row 测试.xlsx, first row included, complete three-result generation and document preview
Actual ABX project with 36 imported role-specific mono audio assets, 12 generated/shuffled trials, configured F/J response labels; no participant session
M16: real native recording project and task list, microphone not started
Ordinary non-full-screen eighteen-module workbench reader, complete first page at 50% zoom, actual previously published recommendation cached locally; no personal path
Appearance settings with Absolutely light selected

current_readme.scope: All eighteen modules, home and settings. Six richer examples refined on user request: actual monosyllable pitch synthesis; image reconstruction and results; full Chunjiang Huayueye; 5453-row survey and exports; 12-trial ABX design; normal PDF reader with complete first page. Static screenshots only; no camera, microphone or participant acquisition.
